Mortgage LO Compensation & RESPA Guardrails skill: initial release.

- Introduces a dedicated skill for mortgage loan-originator compensation and RESPA Section 8 compliance.
- Provides clear activation and non-activation criteria focused on incentive and referral arrangements.
- Summarizes legal guardrails (LO Comp Rule, RESPA §8) with actionable domain guidance.
- Includes example of compliant/incompliant comp design, compliance checklist, key packs, and red flags.
- For use as an industry "front door" to safe incentive design in mortgage, with legal/compliance sign-off required.
